description: Perform a workflow activity. Workflows Instances transition between states when all required activities have been performed.

parameters.name: workflow_instance_id
parameters.description: ID of the workflow instance to perform the activity on.

id.description: Unique identifier for this workflow activity history.

file_attachments.description: List of file attachments with their identifying metadata

assigned_to_id.description: Login Information ID of the user the activity is assigned to.

assigned_to_name.description: Full name of the user the activity is assigned to.

bic_duration.description: Ball In Court duration in days

comments.description: Comments recorded by the user who performed the activity.

performed_by_id.description: Login Information ID of a Workflow User Role Login Information.

performed_by_name.description: Full name of the user who performed the activity.

workflow_activity_id.description: ID of the workflow activity that was performed.

workflow_activity_name.description: Name of the workflow activity that was performed.

workflow_instance_id.description: ID of the workflow instance the activity was performed on.

workflow_user_role_id.description: ID of the workflow user role the activity was performed under.

workflow_user_role_name.description: Name of the workflow user role the activity was performed under.

workflow_state_id.description: ID of the workflow state the performed activity belongs to.

workflow_state_name.description: Name of the workflow state the performed activity belongs to.

workflow_activity_history.description: Activity to perform on the workflow instance.

workflow_activity_id.description: ID of the workflow activity to perform.

workflow_instance_id.description: ID of the workflow instance to perform the activity on.

workflow_user_role_id.description: ID of the workflow user role the activity is performed under.

performed_by_id.description: Ignored. The activity is always recorded as performed by the authenticated user.

comments.description: Comments to record with the activity.

prostore_file_ids.description: IDs of previously uploaded Prostore Files to attach to this activity history.

attachments.description:
Attachments.
To upload attachments you must upload the entire payload as `multipart/form-data` content-type and
specify each parameter as form-data together with `attachments[]` as files.
